description: This file defines a React functional component named 'GenericKeyValueManager' that provides a flexible user interface for managing key-value pairs within a web application. It includes functionality for adding, editing, deleting, and saving key-value items, with support for collapsible UI sections, custom actions, and configuration examples.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a random string ID for new key-value items.

methods.name: handleAddItem
methods.description: Handles adding a new key-value item to the list.

methods.name: handleEditItem
methods.description: Initiates editing mode for a selected item.

methods.name: handleSaveEdit
methods.description: Saves the edits made to an item.

methods.name: handleCancelEdit
methods.description: Cancels the editing mode without saving changes.

methods.name: handleDeleteItem
methods.description: Deletes a specified item from the list.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Executes the optional save action provided via props.
